The '''Pioneer Pickaxe''' is a {{Special}} item, awarded to players who participated in the testing of the [[Crystal Hollows]] on the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]].

== Obtaining ==
A '''Pioneer Pickaxe''' was obtainable by logging on to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]] at least once during testing for the {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}. It could be claimed from {{NPCSprite|Jerry}}'s Personal Deliveries if the player met said requirements.

== Trivia ==
*The inventor of this item, Thomas Pickson, is a reference to [[w:Thomas Edison|Thomas Edison]], often called America's greatest inventor.
*The '''Pioneer Pickaxe''' can only be reforged with [[Reforge Stones]] and not [[Reforging|basic reforging]].
* Because the pickaxe is {{Special}}, when reforged with {{reforgeLink|Refined}}, it gives better stats than the {{Item|Stonk}}, making it give more [[Skill]] XP when collecting Mining [[Minions]].
** When [[Reforging|Reforged]] to {{ReforgeLink|Refined}} and [[Recombobulator 3000|Recombobulated]], this item gives {{stat|mining wisdom|9}} when held. This can be increased to {{stat|mining wisdom|19}} with {{ench|Compact X}}. This is the highest mining exp boost possible from any held item. This pickaxe would also give a {{Green|0.7%}} chance to grant you the enchanted version of blocks you mine (because of Compact).
*This item does 0.25x as much damage as the vanilla [[Wooden Pickaxe]], suggesting the item has {{stat|dmg|3.75}}. However, to enemies that aren't [[Glacite Walker|Glacite Walkers]], it does the same damage as one of the player's fists, and to Glacite Walkers it does 1000x higher damage than fists, contrary to the usual ~154x.
*'''Pioneer Pickaxe''' is the only non-[[Memento]] item given to players for [[Alpha]] testing.
